description: Retrieve structured case records from the International Crimes Database (ICD), including case metadata, parties, categories, keywords, and detailed legal content.

function.description:
要调用的功能名。可用值:
  - get_case: Retrieve a single case record by ID or URL; 参数: case_id, url; 必填: 无
  - list_cases: List all cases or filter by category; 参数: category; 必填: 无
  - list_categories: List available crime categories; 参数: 无; 必填: 无
  - search_cases: Search cases by name/keyword; 参数: query; 必填: 无

url.description: Full or relative case URL for get_case (e.g., "/Case/147/Kambanda/")

query.description: Search query for search_cases (matches against case names)
